# PROSTHETIC VALVE ENDOCARDITIS WITH STREPTOCOCCUS

# Treatment of highly susceptible viridians streptococci or Streptococcus

# gallolyticus (bovis) (penicillin MIC less than or equal to 0.12 mcg/ml)

Addition of gentamicin to penicillin or ceftriaxone is optional, as combination

therapy has not demonstrated superior outcomes. Contact Infectious Diseases for

more information.

Preferred:

[Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h \($$\) R for 6 weeks](psjizid-penicillin-g-4-million-units-iv-q4h)

< OR >

[Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h \($$\) R for 6 weeks <AND> gentamicin](orz-set-abx-penicillin-4mu-iv-q4h-gent-3-mg-kg-iv-qd)

3 mg/kg IV q24h  ($) [R,O] for 2 weeks

< OR >

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h \($\) for 6 weeks](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)

< OR >

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h \($\) for 6 weeks <AND> gentamicin 3 mg/kg IV q24h](orz-set-abx-ceft-2gm-iv-q24h-gent-3-mg-kg-iv-once-daily)

($) [R,O] for 2 weeks

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction CLICK HERE](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R for 6 weeks](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)

# Treatment of relatively resistant viridians streptococci or S. gallolyticus

# (bovis) (penicillin MIC greater than 0.12 and less than or equal to 0.5 mcg/ml)

Preferred:

[Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h \($$\) R <AND> gentamicin 1 mg/kg IV q24h](orz-set-abx-penicillin-4mu-iv-q4h-gent-3-mg-kg-iv-qd)

($) [R,O] both drugs for 6 weeks

< OR >

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h \($\) <AND> gentamicin 1 mg/kg IV QD  \($\) R,O both](orz-set-abx-ceft-2gm-iv-q24h-gent-3-mg-kg-iv-once-daily)

drugs for 6 weeks

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction CLICK HERE](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R for 6 weeks](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)

# Treatment of highly resistant viridians streptococci or S. gallolyticus (bovis)

# (penicillin MIC greater than or equal to 0.5 mcg/mL)

Preferred:

($) [R,O] for 6 weeks

< OR>

[Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h \($$\) R <AND> gentamicin 1 mg/kg IV q8h \($\) R,O](orz-set-abx-ampici-2gm-iv-q4h-gent-1mg-kg-iv-q8h)

for 6 weeks

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction CLICK HERE](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R for 6 weeks](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)

# Treatment of Streptococci pneumonia, Streptococcus pyogenes, and Groups B, C, F

# and G beta-hemolytic streptococci

Treatment is non-standardized and must be tailored to each patient. Consult

Infectious Diseases.
